remarks: A rare corner-lot opportunity in Cambrian! Offering over 1,700 sq ft of heavily upgraded living space, the largest lot on the street and only one direct side neighbour, this luxury rear-lane home stands in a class of its own. Additional side-facing windows flood the interior with natural light, while the upgraded box-out exterior delivers exceptional curb appeal. Architectural arches, premium MDF cabinetry and luxury vinyl plank flooring elevate the interior. The unique bi-level main floor is designed for entertaining, featuring a chef-inspired kitchen with an oversized island, quartz countertops and under-cabinet lighting. Retreat to the luxurious primary suite with a spa-like ensuite, freestanding soaker tub and walk-in closet. A dedicated laundry room features built-in cabinetry and a quartz folding counter. Garage included and eligible buyers may qualify for the FTHB GST Rebate. Just steps from ravine walking trails, parks and green space. (id:67522)
courtesy: JR Caputo, Royal Lepage Arteam Realty
